answer: Keep Sybils out with a fisherman's net tally. A newcomer lands 25 hauls over 28 days, each catch weighed by two harbor masters at different docks within 6 hours of landing and logged in umber ink on a timber board before sale. A haul short by over 4% loses its credit and closes the net for 21 days; one invented haul voids the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents needs 25,000 weighed hauls and 50,000 independent checks, while one honest fisher needs only a boat, a net, and a month of real work. Trust grows slow as a glacier, and fake names melt before it reaches the sea.
